scope: Real services and worker; strict mock persistence, server time, notices, periodic ticks and orchestration collaborators. No EF provider, HTTP pipeline or SQL Server.
limitations: Uncommitted transaction disposal is verified; actual SQL rollback is not executed.
Notice/outbox objects are captured before Save; in-memory mutations may remain after a simulated save failure.
ExecuteAsync orchestration has mock processors; XuLyTuHuyKetNoiAsync is separately executed as the real private worker method via reflection.
Default adapter retains SQL server clock; fixed time is supplied by mock NowAsync during unit tests.
No integration rerun is claimed after these dependency refactors.
